name: Watermelon Merge Simulator!  [Suika]
desc:
👍 Thumbs up to help support the game!

🔊 Completely original soundtrack thanks to ImprintzXD!

🍉Inspired by the physics based puzzle game Suika but very early in development. 

Also includes a 3D mode which is basically an entirely different game with different strategies.

Mouse click or tap the screen to place a fruit, it will drop where your mouse/finger is.  If a fruit reaches the red you'll lose.  Press the "Hold" button to switch your currently dropping fruit and next fruit up!  If you're on keyboard you can press the H key to hold as well.
